placements.role: A second, publicly listed US seabed-mineral permit applicant racing the same NOAA consolidated-review pathway TMC USA-A pioneered: Deep Sea Minerals Corp's US subsidiary filed its own Clarion-Clipperton Zone exploration-license application under the Deep Seabed Hard Mineral Resources Act, which NOAA determined to be in substantial compliance on June 1, 2026, and the company submitted an amended application on July 17, 2026.
